notes_for_editor: Coordinates conflict: the record and websiteservice.ca (52-58-00.3 X 102-37-40.5 = 52.96675, -102.62792) agree, while firelookout.ca gives 52.985095, -102.629752, about 2 km further north. Not checked on a map; the record is kept unchanged. The firelookout.ca note is undated, submitted by QL2C, and its 2010 cupola date is unverified. The towermen list's 'went to aerial detection' is read as the towerman's next job, not the tower's fate. No agency source for this tower; the brief's SPSA line is unsupported. The brief's status 'unknown' is changed to standing on the firelookout.ca note alone. The brief has no local_unit; 'Hudson Bay No. 394' is as firelookout.ca gives it. Search budget: one search used for this tower.
